items.claim: Manel Sousa is too explosive for Richie Miranda.
items.quote: I think Manel Sousa is too damn explosive for Richie Miranda.

items.claim: Richie Miranda trains at Bloodline with good talent.
items.quote: Richie Miranda has been training at Bloodline, which I happen to think is a good team.

items.claim: Richie Miranda's boxing is not good and he lacks pop on his shots.
items.quote: his boxing's not good and he doesn't have pop on his shots.

items.claim: Richie Miranda lacks the wrestling to get the fight to the ground.
items.quote: I don't think he has the wrestling to be able to get it there.

items.claim: Billy Ray Goff hasn't fought in over a year.
items.quote: Billy Ray Goff hasn't fought in over a year

items.claim: Ty Miller is tall and long with a 6'2 height and 77 and 1/2 inch reach.
items.quote: Ty Miller very, very good with his straight punches, very good kicker. Ty Miller could do it all. 6'2, 77 and 1/2 inch reach.

items.claim: Billy Ray Goff lost his recent fights against Ramiz Brahimaj and Trevin Giles.
items.quote: coming off of the Rami Ramiz Brahimaj, where he got smashed by Ramiz Brahimaj, lost to Trevin Giles as well.

items.claim: Darren Elkins has accumulated a massive amount of wear and tear over his career.
items.quote: Darren Elkins has 400,000 miles on a [__] car.

items.claim: Darren Elkins has only been submitted once in his MMA career.
items.quote: Darren Elkins has been submitted once in his whole in his whole whole mixed martial arts career.

items.claim: Yair Del Valle has an excellent submission game and excels at taking the back.
items.quote: Yair Del Valle is like a magnet to the back. He gets right to the back... Yair Del Valle's submission game should be excellent.

items.claim: Yair Del Valle's boxing is slow and subpar.
items.quote: Yair Del Valle's boxing is slow and kind of bad.

items.claim: Amanda Lemos struggles against good grapplers and gets taken down.
items.quote: She doesn't do well against good grapplers. You could check the Tatiana Suarez fight. You could check a lot of her fights. She gets taken down.
